Context: 10. Fee and Honorarium

3. Share of the fee payable to Government.One-third of any fees in excess of ~ 5,000 in a financial year subject to a minimum of ~ 5,000 being retained by the Government servant. The Competent Authority may, however, grant permission exempting the employee from payment of share to Government. - Notfn., dated 15-11-2021.
